findings.text: The company status is recorded as 'dissolved', and it ceased on 22 December 2025.
One insolvency case is on record: a members' voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987, and its age at cessation is recorded as 38.2 years (13936 days).
The accounts are of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; the last accounts were made up to 31 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; the last statement was made up to 5 March 2025.
The register records 2 current officers: 1 director, PERSON 268 (appointed 11 May 2022), and 1 other officer.
PERSON 268 has 11 other appointments, of which 8 are active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation; the director is therefore linked to a company in an insolvency process.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, holding 75 to 100 percent ownership of shares. No charges are registered against the company.
